MODEL_VERSION_NOTE: Legacy string constant FROZEN_MODEL_V2_VERSION; suffix '120M' is a historical label. Actual enforced Contract A window is 0 < minutes_until_start <= 1440.

UNIVERSE.NOTE: produceFrozenModelV2ShadowDecisions has no sport filter (only eSports exclusion). Football scope is applied by the committed fail-closed football classifier reused by scripts/modeling/build-football-denominator-reconciliation-v2.ts (imports v1 pure functions). Rows whose sport/market type cannot be proven football are excluded (fail-closed).

SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_RULE.T90: eligible source rows: created_at <= game_start - 90 minutes; winner = latest created_at among eligible; tie-break observationId ascending (localeCompare)
SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_RULE.LATE_SNAPSHOT: a row created after the T-90 boundary is never eligible and cannot displace an earlier valid snapshot
SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_RULE.VISIBILITY: rows with created_at > asOf rejected FUTURE_DATA_REJECTED; unparsable created_at rejected SNAPSHOT_NOT_T90_COMPATIBLE
SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_RULE.LEAKAGE: winning_outcome / real_pnl_usd never read by producer

ELIGIBILITY_GATES.MARKET_TYPE: BINARY only (SUPPORTED_MARKET_TYPES = BINARY, binary); a present non-BINARY market_type is rejected UNSUPPORTED_MARKET
ELIGIBILITY_GATES.MARKET_TYPE_NOTE: Producer admits rows whose market_type/marketType field is absent or blank (only present-and-non-BINARY is rejected). V3 preserves this producer semantics unchanged; flagged for Final Review as OPEN_ITEM_MARKET_TYPE_ABSENT_ADMITTED.

TIMING.REFERENCE: minutes_until_start = (diagnostics.gameStartIso - asOf) / 60000 (physical event lead time at the evaluation instant, not observation age)

PHYSICAL_EVENT_GROUPING.FUNCTION: buildEventGroupKey (lib/modeling/eventGroupSelection.ts), fallback to condition_id when key empty
PHYSICAL_EVENT_GROUPING.SCOPE: one bet per physical event over eligible siblings only

EXACT_IDENTITY_CONTRACT.CARRIER: decision.observationId = condition_id::selected_token_id plus decision.selectedOutcome; condition_id/token_id are read from the source export row matched by observationId (as frozenExecutionContractBridge does)

SETTLEMENT_POLICY.RESOLVER: strict terminal resolver (scripts/modeling/step4c-strict-terminal-resolver.ts classifyStrict), research/evaluation only

FAIL_CLOSED_POLICY.REFERENCE_NOT_REIMPLEMENTATION: V3 references production functions; it does not copy or reimplement them

RESEARCH_FREEZE: Sep1-12 provenance, Founder 301 reconstruction, 66-batch S2 closure, remaining selector replay, new market/timing/odds/score/estimator/momentum searches are CLOSED for V3; ideas go to V4 backlog
